sel: .pb body text (boxes, order, story, b2b, visit sections)

note: 11px is below any comfortable size
phone 22px is not large text
informational text, not exempt

sel: .b2b-copy p  on-btn at opacity .86 on btn

note: b.css itself says caramel is "graphics only, never small text"

sel: ring outside .btn-b--main / .order / .label .row a:first-child: ring vs the button fill
note: informative only: the 3px offset leaves a strip of page colour between ring and fill
the icon identifies the button, so this border is not required; listed because it is the only shape cue
hover wash; micro also draws the caramel stroke, so this is not the only cue
card edge; shadow also separates
